target: AArch64 PCI QEMU, one guest CPU, focused graphical terminal
checks: The stock LoadTest source ran in the focused graphical app task and displayed its running status and PRESS A KEY prompt.
A key event stopped the app; cooperative worker tasks completed, the app task exited, and focus returned to the graphical terminal.
The terminal evaluated 40+2 as 42, and zstatus reported failed=0.
The ARM64 source bundle replaces the unavailable x86 AOT Compiler.ZXE worker with repeated JIT loading of stock Demo/Print.ZC and Yield, retaining a cooperative compile-worker stress loop.
The overlay maps stock CPU-1 worker requests to CPU 0 because the current guest bridge schedules only CPU 0; this run does not test SMP.
scope_note: QEMU runtime acceptance of the ARM64-adapted LoadTest path only. This does not establish SMP scheduling, availability of the stock x86 AOT compiler, live UTM acceptance, or physical Pi acceptance.
